zh.title: 玩一会儿
zh.summary: 找不同、闯迷宫，或来一局霓虹街机。
intro: 从树木找不同和火光迷宫，到霓虹街机与像素冒险，这里收集了风格各异的网页游戏。
先看看作品画面和简短介绍，再前往创作者原站开始探索。
selection_notes: 喜欢安静观察，可以试试找不同或迷宫；想要动作与策略，可以看看街机、机器人和无人机作品。
像素故事、手作世界和太空探索提供了不同的冒险体验；作品详情记录了已知限制和检查情况。

work_notes.tree-appreciator: 对照两棵树的枝叶找不同，适合喜欢安静观察的人。
work_notes.labyrinthos: 带着一簇火光寻找迷宫出口，重点是路线探索。
work_notes.hyperbrick: 霓虹街机打砖块与关卡挑战；画面包含闪光效果。
work_notes.hearthlight: 在像素海边小镇开启冒险；创作者提示游戏仍可能有问题。
work_notes.star-hop: 把握时机在行星间跳跃；创作者称游戏仍在测试中。
work_notes.battle-drones: 收集资源、建造无人机并展开即时策略对战；已检查到 AI 对局开局。
work_notes.knockbots: 三维机器人竞技场提供训练和街机选项；完整对战尚未核验。
work_notes.lili-last-door: 跟随莉莉进入午夜像素故事；目前已核验到序章对话。
work_notes.afterlight: 像素角色与三维场景结合的末日后冒险，从灯塔小镇展开。
work_notes.felt-world: 在针毡风格世界里探索；已观察到进入场景并开车。
work_notes.null-range: 在多人共享星区驾驶飞船并使用声呐；完整对战尚未核验。

en.title: A little time to play
en.summary: Spot the differences, explore a maze or step into a neon arcade.
intro: From spotting differences in trees and navigating a torchlit maze to neon arcade action and pixel adventures, these browser games offer different ways to play.
Preview each creation and its short introduction, then visit the creator's original site to explore.
selection_notes: For quiet observation, try the tree puzzle or maze; for action and strategy, explore the arcade, robot and drone games.
Pixel stories, a handmade-looking world and space journeys offer different kinds of adventure. Each detail page records known limitations and checks.

work_notes.tree-appreciator: Compare the branches and leaves of two trees in a quiet spot-the-difference puzzle.
work_notes.labyrinthos: Carry a small flame through a maze and search for the exit.
work_notes.hyperbrick: Break bricks and tackle arcade levels amid neon visuals; the game contains flashing effects.
work_notes.hearthlight: Begin an adventure in a pixel-art seaside village; the creator notes that the game may contain bugs.
work_notes.star-hop: Time jumps between planets; the creator says the game is still in testing.
work_notes.battle-drones: Gather resources and build a drone swarm for real-time strategy; the start of an AI match was checked.
work_notes.knockbots: A 3D robot arena offers Training and Arcade options; a complete match has not been verified.
work_notes.lili-last-door: Follow Lili into a midnight pixel story; the opening dialogue has been checked.
work_notes.afterlight: A post-apocalyptic adventure pairs pixel characters with 3D scenes, beginning in a lighthouse town.
work_notes.felt-world: Explore a felt-like world; entering the scene and driving have been observed.
work_notes.null-range: Pilot a ship and use sonar in a shared multiplayer sector; full combat has not been verified.

zh.title: 声音实验室
zh.summary: 从手风琴到鼓机，用声音和节奏自由探索。
intro: 这组作品把乐器、节奏、文字和视觉放在一起：可以看看网页手风琴、合成器、鼓机与声音画面。
每件作品的操作和核验情况不同，打开详情可了解更多。
selection_notes: 想尝试乐器或节奏，可以从 Web-Bayan、Soft Machine 和 mpump 开始。
想从视觉入手，可以看看 Type Sound 的文字与色彩、PULSE 的动态画面，或 Luminote 的光条；部分作品的音频尚未实际听测。

work_notes.type-sound: 键盘输入让彩色字母出现；声音尚未实际听测。
work_notes.mpump: 鼓组、合成器与效果控制集中在一个界面；音频尚未实际听测。
work_notes.web-bayan: 用键盘或鼠标探索巴扬手风琴的按钮与音栓；按键高亮已检查，音频未听测。
work_notes.soft-machine: 合成器提供琴键、旋钮和步进音序器；完整交互尚未核验。
work_notes.pulse: 生成音乐与动态视觉组合；画面包含闪动效果。
work_notes.luminote: 钢琴键盘与下落光条将旋律呈现为画面。
work_notes.stave: 把字母排在琴弦上并尝试播放；音频尚未实际听测。

en.title: Sounds to play
en.summary: Explore instruments, beats and sound-driven visuals.
intro: These works bring together instruments, rhythm, text and visuals, from a browser accordion to synthesizers, a drum machine and sound-driven images.
Interactions and checks vary by work; open a detail page to learn more.
selection_notes: For instruments or beats, start with Web-Bayan, Soft Machine or mpump.
For visuals, look at Type Sound's colored letters, PULSE's animation or Luminote's falling lights. Audio has not been audibly verified for some works.

work_notes.type-sound: Typing brings colored letters onto the canvas; audio has not been audibly verified.
work_notes.mpump: Drums, synthesizers and effects share one interface; audio has not been audibly verified.
work_notes.web-bayan: Explore a bayan accordion's buttons and registers with a keyboard or mouse; key highlights were checked, but audio was not heard.
work_notes.soft-machine: A synthesizer with keys, knobs and a step sequencer; its full interaction has not been verified.
work_notes.pulse: Generative music is paired with animated visuals that include flashing effects.
work_notes.luminote: A piano keyboard and falling lights turn melodies into a visual display.
work_notes.stave: Arrange letters across strings and try playback; audio has not been audibly verified.

en.title: Interactive Music & Browser Sound Experiments — Freemy
en.description: Preview a browser accordion, synthesizers, a drum machine and sound-driven visuals, with notes on what was checked.

zh.title: 拆开机器看看
zh.summary: 从发动机到机械臂，动手探索机器与运动。
intro: 从发动机、液压到机器人和航天器，这些作品呈现机器的结构、运动或制造过程。
它们既有简化的原理演示，也有装配场景和三维展馆；模拟程度与已检查操作因作品而异。
selection_notes: 想看零件和传力，可以从 V8 Engine、FORM / 01 或液压演示开始。
想探索装配或移动，可以看看 RoboLabs、Drone Lab 和火星车；各作品详情记录了已知的使用限制。

work_notes.v8-engine: 调整四冲程 V8 转速并切换至气缸视图，观察活塞和气门。
work_notes.form-01: 在爆炸视图中环视机械臂的齿轮、关节和走线。
work_notes.drone-lab: 选择无人机预设，观察重量与推力，再在飞行场观看自动驾驶；手动飞行未测。
work_notes.learn-arduino: 转动开发板并运行 Blink 示例，观察电路中的 LED 闪烁。
work_notes.hydraulics: 调整输入力，观察活塞传力和挖掘机动作；这是简化演示。
work_notes.terrain-rover: 切换沙丘与透视视图，并短距离驾驶六轮探测车。
work_notes.robolabs: 在工作台试装零件，再到试驾场移动；仅核验首步装配和短距离行驶。
work_notes.roadster-explorer: 从材料到轮组浏览想象中的汽车装配；部分细节为估算。
work_notes.wind-tide: 选择离岸风场并拖动时间轴，观察场景与读数变化。
work_notes.spacex-vehicles: 浏览 Starship 等航天器模型，并从下方查看发动机。
work_notes.bee-x9: 接管机械蜂导览，观察飞行和模拟仪表。

en.title: Machines in motion
en.summary: Explore engines, robotic arms and flight through interaction.
intro: From engines and hydraulics to robots and spacecraft, these works present the structure, movement or making of machines.
They include simplified demonstrations, assembly scenes and 3D exhibits; simulations and verified interactions vary by work.
selection_notes: To inspect parts and force, begin with V8 Engine, FORM / 01 or the hydraulics demonstration.
For assembly or movement, explore RoboLabs, Drone Lab and the terrain rover. Each detail page records known limitations.

work_notes.v8-engine: Change a four-stroke V8's speed and switch to a cylinder view to inspect the piston and valves.
work_notes.form-01: Look around the robotic arm's gears, joints and wiring in an exploded view.
work_notes.drone-lab: Choose a drone preset, observe weight and thrust, then watch autopilot in the flight field; manual flight was not tested.
work_notes.learn-arduino: Rotate the board and run the Blink example to see a circuit's LED flash.
work_notes.hydraulics: Adjust input force and watch the pistons and excavator respond in a simplified demonstration.
work_notes.terrain-rover: Switch to dunes and X-Ray views, then drive the six-wheeled rover a short distance.
work_notes.robolabs: Try fitting a part at the workbench and moving in the test area; only the first assembly step and a short drive were checked.
work_notes.roadster-explorer: Follow an imagined car build from materials to wheels; some details are estimates.
work_notes.wind-tide: Choose an offshore wind farm and move the timeline to observe changes in the scene and readings.
work_notes.spacex-vehicles: Explore models including Starship and view its engines from below.
work_notes.bee-x9: Take over a robotic bee's tour and observe its flight and simulated readouts.
